segments.en: It is day 6. Alex is still new on the team. Alex is new, so the team uses short sentences. In the morning, Maria helps me use the "bug" and "error message" for a small task. During our chat, she says "How do I get to ...?" and "Is it far from here?". I answer clearly and ask one short question. After lunch, I work with the team on GitHub and practise "issue" and "open an issue". The task is small, but I understand a little more than yesterday.
